name: ir-blob
description: Bright-mass centroid over the lit infrared frame: the brightest connected mass's normalized center, its coverage of the frame, and the mean luminance above threshold. Not illumination-response (lit minus unlit) — the FaceAuth camera graph publishes only the lit half.

channels.name: x
channels.description: The bright mass's horizontal center, -1 (left) to 1 (right).

channels.name: y
channels.description: The bright mass's vertical center, -1 (bottom) to 1 (top).

channels.name: coverage
channels.description: The fraction of pixels above threshold.

channels.name: luminance
channels.description: The mean luminance of the pixels above threshold.

threshold.description: The per-pixel luminance floor a pixel must clear to weigh into the mass.

minCoverage.description: The coverage fraction confidence saturates at.
